summary: Several studies have directly applied federated learning techniques to the problem of hate speech detection. Brennan et al. (2018) [V0108] used decentralised training without pooled records on the FireScope dataset, achieving an F1 score of 0.66. Adebayo et al. (2026) [V0107] applied a similar approach on ProtMap, reporting an AUROC of 0.94. Gupta et al. (2024) [V0105] studied hate speech detection on ToxiBench, achieving an accuracy of 0.8. Brennan et al. (2018) [V0114] compared baselines with multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling on GridWatch, achieving an F1 score of 0.74. Haddad et al. (2025) [V0106] applied decentralised training without pooled records on GridWatch, reporting a test MAE of 0.87.
